soldier: The head is yellowish brown, the mandibles purplish brown, the hairs of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is somewhat elliptical, the sides slightly expanding posteriorly, widest near the posterior end, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frontal region is slightly projecting, slightly concave behind the frons. The labrum is nearly circular, its apex bluntly rounded and projecting outwards, the anterior quarter semi-transparent, bearing apical and subapical hairs. The mandibles are long and strong, the inner margin rather straight, the apices slightly curved, the mandibular condyle visible. Antennae with 16–17 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies between the anterior one-fifth and the anterior one-sixth, the sides of the waist region parallel. The pronotum is nearly kidney-shaped, the anterior margin straight with a distinct median notch, the sides together with the posterior margin forming a broad arc with a shallow median notch, with four to six hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.
